datasetVersion.termsOfUse:
The following uses are permitted under this agreement:

Viewing, analyzing, and interpreting the data for non-commercial research, teaching, and academic writing.

Comparing the dataset with other non-identifiable datasets for analytical purposes.

Extracting approved snippets for inclusion in publications, theses, presentations, or other academic outputs, provided citation requirements are met.
datasetVersion.specialPermissions: Access to the full dataset, including transcript files and annotated content, requires a prior consultation with the dataset authors. Prospective users must explain the intended purpose of use and obtain confirmation before download or analysis.
datasetVersion.restrictions:
Use of the dataset is  subject to the following conditions:

No redistribution: Users may not share the data with third parties without prior written permission from the dataset authors.

No re-identification: Users must not attempt to identify any individual participants through the data, nor link the dataset with other sources to infer identities.

No commercial use: The data may not be used in any project or product intended for commercial benefit.

No misuse of context: Snippets and transcript content must not be quoted out of context or in ways that misrepresent participant voices.

Time-limited access: Use of the data is limited to a period of three years from the date of access unless an extension is granted in writing.

Secure handling: The dataset must be stored on password-protected, access-controlled devices and systems.
datasetVersion.citationRequirements:
Users must cite the dataset using the persistent identifier (DOI), title, and author(s) as indicated on the dataset page.

Any publications or presentations derived from this dataset must include a clear and accurate citation.
datasetVersion.depositorRequirements: Users must submit copies of all publications, presentations, or reports resulting from the use of this dataset to the dataset authors for archiving and review.
datasetVersion.disclaimer:
All users are responsible for:

Ensuring ethical handling and interpretation of the data in line with relevant institutional and disciplinary guidelines.

Protecting the confidentiality of research participants at all times.

Accurate representation of quotes, codes, and findings in their outputs.
datasetVersion.termsOfAccess: This is data that has been used for a doctoral research project and should remain private. Permission to download the data may only be given after discussing the intended use in a personal consultation with the authors of this project.
datasetVersion.availabilityStatus: The data will be made available under the terms of use and access.
